# technitium_group (Data Source)

Reads what `technitium_group` manages, without managing it, found by `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "technitium_group" "administrators" {
  name = "Administrators"
}

resource "technitium_group_members" "administrators" {
  group   = data.technitium_group.administrators.name
  members = ["admin"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The group name. Changing it replaces the group. Deleting or replacing the group also removes its members and its rights in `technitium_permissions_*` and `technitium_zone_permissions`: add `replace_triggered_by` on the `technitium_group_members` and permissions resources that name it to set them again in the same apply.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The group description.
- `id` (String) The identifier, as the resource has it.
